title: 99-04 Mustang Wilwood Front Pro-Street Brake Kit
description:
Upgrade your SN95 or New Edge Mustang's front stopping power with the Wilwood DynaPro Radial Front Drag Brake Kit (140-10016). Engineered for high-speed drag racing and street/strip performance, this kit drops significant rotating weight while fitting inside popular 15" drag wheels.

Featuring 4-piston radial-mount forged calipers and heavy-duty 0.81" vented rotors, this setup delivers rigid clamping force and thermal capacity built to handle high-speed trap stops without structural deflection.

#### What’s Included:

* DynaPro 4-Piston Calipers: Forged billet aluminum radial-mount calipers in durable black anodize.
* 11.75" x 0.81" Vented Rotors: Heavy-duty steel rotor design for superior heat dissipation on street/strip vehicles over 2,800 lbs.
* Billet Aluminum Hubs: Precision-machined hubs with dual 5-lug bolt patterns (5x4.5" & 5x4.75").
* Installation Hardware: Caliper mounting brackets, wheel bearings, grease seals, dust caps, and grade-8 hardware.

#### Key Specs & Notes:

* Wheel Clearance: Designed specifically to clear most 15" drag wheels.
* Spindle Fitment: Direct bolt-on for 1994–2004 Mustang factory front disc brake spindles.
* Note on Brake Lines: Flexlines are not included with this core kit. Wilwood requires stainless steel flexlines with -3AN fittings (such as Wilwood P/N 220-6458) to connect to chassis hard lines.

#### Vehicle Fitment:

* 1994–2004 Ford Mustang (Base, GT, Mach 1, Bullitt, SVT Cobra)
